1.w: For the music director, according to the shushan-eduth style; a psalm of Asaph. O Shepherd of Israel, pay attention, you who lead Joseph like a flock of sheep. You who sit enthroned above the cherubim, reveal your splendor.

2.w: In the sight of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh reveal your power. Come and deliver us.

3.w: O God, restore us. Smile on us. Then we will be delivered.

4.w: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, how long will you remain angry at your people while they pray to you?

5.w: You have given them tears as food; you have made them drink tears by the measure.

6.w: You have made our neighbors dislike us and our enemies insult us.

7.w: O God of Heaven’s Armies, restore us. Smile on us. Then we will be delivered.

8.w: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; you drove out nations and transplanted it.

9.w: You cleared the ground for it; it took root and filled the land.

10.w: The mountains were covered by its shadow, the highest cedars by its branches.

11.w: Its branches reached the Mediterranean Sea, and its shoots the Euphrates River.

12.w: Why did you break down its walls, so that all who pass by pluck its fruit?

13.w: The wild boars of the forest ruin it; the insects of the field feed on it.

14.w: O God of Heaven’s Armies, come back. Look down from heaven and take notice. Take care of this vine,

15.w: the root your right hand planted, the shoot you made to grow.

16.w: It is burned and cut down. May those who did this die because you are displeased with them.

17.w: May you give support to the one you have chosen, to the one whom you raised up for yourself.

18.w: Then we will not turn away from you. Revive us and we will pray to you.

19.w: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, restore us. Smile on us. Then we will be delivered.
